content.body:
The CDSW was the most reliable and versatile tractor/puller in its class. It could haul any of the Allied guns and artillery, although it is most often associated with the Bofors 40 mm AA gun and the 17 pounder.
The Morris is a Resupply vehicle and will provide ammunition to infantry and other ground units that are stopped near it.
content.brief: TYPE: Prime Mover/Gun Tractor TOWING CAPACITY: Heavy LOAD: 3,810 kg WEIGHT: 1,524 kg SPEED: 65 km/h (road)
content.title: Morris CDSW Truck
